_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/settings.local.json for anything that must NOT be
shared: machine-specific permission rules, a different model on a
weaker box, env vars. Local overrides the shared settings.json.
Deliberately gitignored -- permission rules in particular tend to
embed absolute paths and machine names.
_statusLine_comment: WINDOWS ONLY -- delete this block on Linux, macOS and WSL, where the
Windows has no exec bit for .sh, so the shared settings.json command
`~/.claude/statusline.sh` is not run but OPENED via the .sh file
association. With .sh associated to an editor, the script pops open
in that editor on every statusline refresh, which is several times a
minute. Routing it through Git Bash executes it instead.
Needs jq on the Git Bash PATH: winget install jqlang.jq. It is not
bundled with Git for Windows. Adjust the path if Git is installed
elsewhere; no quotes around it, as the default path has no spaces.
